drhp.business: Vikram Thermo (India) manufactures, markets and exports pharmaceutical excipients and polymers, mainly acrylic-based methacrylic acid copolymers sold under the DRUGCOAT brand. Its polymers are used for enteric and film coating, sustained and controlled release, moisture barrier coating and taste masking, and it also offers ready-to-use DRCOAT coating systems, APION ion-exchange resins for taste masking and AQUAPOL cosmetic polymers. Customers are mainly pharmaceutical and cosmetics manufacturers in India, and the company also exports. Its former aromatic chemicals business, including diphenyl oxide, was demerged into Vikram Aroma Limited under an NCLT-approved scheme in 2024. The company has filed US DMFs for its products and has a US distribution partnership with Barentz for its coating polymers.
